It is not an animation-frame factor in this lifecycle.

facts.value: Prepares friction or direction-sensitive acceleration for the running turnaround. Nonzero target and acceleration opposite saved entry-facing permit explicit acceleration; otherwise friction is selected. Target correction is conditional and does not guarantee projected velocity never exceeds the target. Ground movement helpers prepare vectors for later integration.
facts.rationale: Resolve the union alias from canonical offsets, preserve signed guard and call ordering, separate animation requests from immediate effects and conditional correction from a global target clamp. Existing objects corroborate pool extent and flags only.

facts.value: Computes stick-derived acceleration and target. Selects friction for zero target or acceleration that does not oppose saved entry-facing. Otherwise applies the sign-specific friction correction and clamps to target_vel-gr_vel only if that correction crosses the target. Writes ground acceleration and prepares ground-normal-aligned animation/self velocity vectors. A corrected projection may remain beyond target, so this is not an unconditional target clamp.
